Nodes carry a trigger line saying when they apply; a base can be injected"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" in full or as an index."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-knowledge-canvas"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness that the model retrieves from **by judgement, not by similarit"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"y** — and that you edit on a canvas in the sidebar."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Edit knowledge on a canvas: parent/child relationships, associations, four layouts, and resizable "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nodes.
- Collapse branches and reveal the path to search results. Long notes scroll; title-only node"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s offer a reading preview.
- Choose full-text or on-demand injection per base, with individual node "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"overrides.
- Review model edits and inspect which nodes were read, written or removed.
- Read sessio"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"n-scoped diaries as a notebook and reply from the sidebar.
- Attach images and files; choose on-dema"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"nd or required attachment reading per workspace."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Usage manual · Changelog · GitHub Releases"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**You explain something, and the next conversation still does not know it — or worse, it thinks it d"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"oes, and the note is stale.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This is not a context-window problem. Measured in one workspace:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**13 writes, 1 read** — and that read was from a different base. Knowledge was *recorded* and never "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"*used*. Recording is free: the model does it in passing. Using is the hard part: you have to know th"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"e entry exists, and which one still holds."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What makes this different"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Every node ends with a line beginning 「什么时候该想起它：」 — "when should this come to mind". - **It does not sync anywhere.** Everything is under `<workspace>/.dsh-knowledge/`, plain JS"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ON: open it in Notepad, commit it, copy the folder. No account, no server.
- **The diary's sealing s"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"tops accidents, not readers.** The key is derived from the base name, so anyone who reads this sourc"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"e can decrypt. Stopping a model that goes looking needs a key that never touches the disk — a passwo"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"rd or an OS credential — which is a different design.
- **It does not write a persona.** Diary mode "},{"id":"p34s7","text":"injects writing conventions, not a tone.
- **No full-text search.** The box does substring matching "},{"id":"p34s8","text":"over titles and bodies; no index, no embeddings."}],"truncated":true}
